task: Fix piano onset random-stream discontinuity at fractional principal-mode budget boundaries
status: passed-local; full Engine/native qualification remains root responsibility
cause: The fractional piano principal-mode budget uses ceil(). Adding a barely weighted principal mode advanced the shared RNG once more, changing all following coupled-course detunings/phases and contact noise at an otherwise tiny tuning change.

production_reachability.description: Engine computes float bodyNote from the tuned target pitch, masterTune, rank-II detune, tuningRef and footage. Scala/MTS and fine tuning can cross these boundaries at note onset. Live pitch bend alone does not restart the body.
production_reachability.scope: An onset voicing discontinuity, not an asserted running-note click.

fix.description: Snapshot the strike-seeded RNG before principal phases; after those phases, restore that snapshot and reserve all42 principal random slots before creating coupled courses. Coupled phases/detuning and subsequent contact texture no longer depend on the number of admitted principal modes.
properties: No new per-sample work, dynamic allocation, state member, parameter or model.
Principal-mode amplitudes, coverage fade, decay, onset and Nyquist guards are unchanged.
Private strike seeds still create distinct onsets.
Other models retain their original RNG sequence.
Piano notes already using all42 principal modes remain bit-identical in the preservation probe.
fix.cost: 42 extra xorshift advances at piano note onset only, replacing a variable implicit starting point with a fixed schedule.

regression.method: Onset pitches straddle each boundary while tick playback frequency is held at the center. RMS-match paired audio and compute waveform residual. Require residual below -60dB for epsilon0.001 and -80dB for epsilon0.0001, and at least15dB convergence as epsilon shrinks. Separately require two different seeds to produce a nontrivial residual.

old_header_negative_control.failure_scope: All72 added waveform continuity/convergence assertions reject the old header; all other tests pass.

regression.measurement_precision: Printed residual extrema rounded to0.001dB; complete logs preserved below.

fixture.modulation: Pressure0 to0.8 at sample1024; one-semitone frequency rise at sample2048.

preservation_probe.expectation: Every non-piano model, including Off, and piano notes24/36 compare float bits exactly. Piano60/96 may change and must remain finite/bounded.

reproduction.old_header_reconstruction: Extract reproduction.files["production.h"] from32-alias-register.json to before/core/InstrumentBody.h. For the probe before-namespaced.h, replace namespace cs80::body with namespace cs80_before::body. Save the new production header beside the probe as after.h.
